title: ep1.5_backstop.xlsx
logline: One check stamped COMMITTED laps NopeAI, its chip seller and its landlords, lighting a data center every lap, and Mas rides it. Nobody can stamp it PAID. NopeAI HQ unfolds into a robot with a 'public benefit' smiley, the wall clock finally dates the intern, and the CFO is about to say one word.

beats.caption: YRRAL on his yacht, sash: RICHEST MAN ALIVE (ONE DAY ONLY). The hull opens into a server hall.
At midnight the sash fades. A $300B check blows onto a pier carousel and starts it turning. Mas at the booth.
INTRO · the cold-open line is an auto-caption strip under a waveform. Then the file card.
SET-PIECE · THE ROUND TABLE game show: HOW MUCH WILL YOU INVEST? Buzzers light up. Nole's chair is empty.

lines.text: thank you for being such a pro-business, pro-innovation president.
This is definitely a high-IQ group.

beats.caption: A third gold thread stitches into his hoodie.
beats.vo: i was just being polite. polite is free.

beats.caption: The ride begins from his seat, glass in the cup holder. The news passes as scenery, one landmark a lap.
beats.real: 2025-09-05 · the department renamed; the $1.5B authors settlement
cues: lap 3: KING LARCHES hands every CEO his speech; a crate bounces between two tollbooths

beats.caption: F6.2 · Nesnej hand-delivers a box to Nole. The label flips 2025 → 2016: he carried the first one in too.
cues: the new box's label unrolls into THE PLAN (one stop)

beats.caption: THE PLAN · THE MONEY-GO-ROUND: a COMMITTED check laps INVIDIA → NopeAI → ELCARO → INVIDIA, bigger every lap.
onscreen: A COMMITMENT IS NOT A PAYMENT.
cues: it never goes to plan: the PAID stamp comes down dry; a tiny taxpayer in the margin holds the ink pad

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · Riders pile on. NopeAI's $500B secondary pops a collar. INVIDIA hits $5T. His glass never ripples.
One lap, a Michigan field: a township's NO on the cathedral door. Next lap, an envelope. SETTLED. It lights.
beats.real: 2025-10 · a township says no, then settles
cues: the hand is the developer's; it lands on Mas's blank face: it's his company's site

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · The toll gate: the far bank hangs a bar magnet on its arm, a 100% weight lands on ours. It balances.
His monitor: KCAJ's lantern throws a creature's shadow on the wall. SKCAS stamps it FEAR-MONGERING.

lines.text: …a sophisticated regulatory capture strategy based on fear-mongering.

cues: DIRE's checkbook snaps open at SKCAS's: donors on both sides (2 s)
the statement collects signatures from both ends, NONNAB included

beats.caption: Out through his window: for a beat, the creature's shadow lies across NopeAI HQ's own facade. It slides off.
SET-PIECE · THE TRANSFORMER: HQ unfolds into a robot, MACROSOFT its right arm, a PUBLIC BENEFIT smiley on it.
cues: style moment (proposed): THE MASK, 6–8 frames of masked GLYPH: the smiley is pinned to the creature; Mas never sees it
a thin wire runs from the AGI switch to one key on Tasya's ring

beats.caption: BUKAJ promises a research intern by Sep 2026. In the dark room, the wall clock clatters and finds dates.
beats.vo: it's just an intern. someone to help with the work.
beats.real: 2025-10-28 · 'an automated AI research intern by Sept 2026'
cues: through the interior window, an orange-cuffed hand screws a RESERVED plate onto an empty desk

beats.caption: F6.3 · The robot's head pops off; a 100x CAP hat from 2019 flutters out. A bigger hat drops on.
A podcast, host unseen: how does $13B of revenue pay for $1.4T? His answer, warm.
Nole's post falls as hail. F6.1 · NOLE'S VERSION of THE WOODROSE: he takes the head seat, hangs the OPEN neon.
beats.real: 2015 · the founding, as Nole tells it
cues: his grievance: money, and fear of ELGOOG; the receipt curls into the carousel's check

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · BACKSTOP: the CFO says the word; a baseball backstop rises behind HQ, taxpayers in the bleachers.

lines.text: taxpayers should not bail out companies that make bad business decisions.

cues: the tiny taxpayer from THE PLAN sits in the front row, still holding the ink pad

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · The carousel coasts to a stop: Mas and TASYA alone in one car. The look is the question.
cues: his key ring starts to jingle, one clink, and he closes his fist on it. That is the reply.

beats.caption: Inside the Orb's iris, its replay counter rewinds NOV 25 → SEP 30 through every face it has scanned: all Mas.
SET-PIECE · CAMEO CITY: AROS 2 floods the city with deepfake Mases. The real one walks through unseen.
cues: style moment (proposed, drastic): a near-photoreal empty street; every Mas the same pixel sprite; no photoreal person

beats.caption: His monitor: Alyi's deposition, 365 pages, only in the table's reflection. One-word answers.
Mario: state hackers used CLOD. KORG flatters its owner. RUMPT's post falls as hail on 50 tiny capitols.

lines.text: We warned you it'd be dangerous. It was ours.

onscreen: POST: "We MUST have one Federal Standard… Put it in the NDAA."
beats.real: 2025-11-13 → 18 · the hacking disclosure; the preemption push

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · INIMEG 3 ships. CODE RED: the siren lifts off ELGOOG's roof, crosses the Bay, and bolts onto his.
cues: he hears it through the ceiling; his glass does not ripple

beats.caption: The CUT DIAL clicks to 25%. An EO preempts the states; the label gun holsters. The states sign anyway.

lines.text: I always thought it should be 'SI'—supreme intelligence…

beats.real: 2025-12-08 → 19 · the H200 cut; EO 14365; RAISE signed

beats.caption: EMIT's Architects of AI: Mas searches the portrait with a magnifying glass. Nesnej: Person of the Year.
BUTTON · Night. The new siren hums in F on the roof. Through the interior window, the RESERVED lamp clicks on.
